verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own docs claim a large marketplace (334k+ Skills, 100k+ MCP servers, 311k+ Agents) with publishing CLIs (lhm, market-cli) and versioning, suggesting a sizable catalog. However all numbers and 'active maintainer' claims come solely from vendor pages; there is no independent evidence (GitHub activity, third-party reviews, download stats) confirming these listings are genuinely maintained or that the community is 'alive' rather than auto-generated/aggregated. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of active maintainers, real usage/download stats, third-party community discussion of specific popular skills/plugins.
